profile.research_note:
Facility specific seeding pass 2026-09-02, batch 63 (Liquid Web missing-address campaign): applied 4428 South Creyts Road as this rows likely address, derived from a facility specific aggregator listing cross corroborated by reverse geocoding this rows own stored coordinates through a separate third party service, both agreeing on street number and street name, and by matching aggregator listed square footage against this operators own stated Data Center A size.

[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] Liquid Web is a privately held web hosting and cloud services company headquartered in Lansing, Michigan, founded in 1997. This specific facility level reading supplements an earlier operator level pass already on file for this operator. This operators own site describes two Lansing area data centers, Data Center A at 32,000 square feet with capacity for 8,000 servers, and Data Center B at 90,000 square feet with capacity for 25,000 servers, but does not publish street addresses for either. This session found a facility specific aggregator listing naming three Lansing facilities with street addresses, DC1 at 4210 South Creyts Road, DC2 at 4428 South Creyts Road, and DC3 at 2703 Ena Drive, the latter identified as headquarters. Reverse geocoding this rows own independently stored coordinates through a separate third party geocoding service returned 4428 Creyts, matching the aggregators DC2 address exactly by street number and street name. Given DC2s aggregator listed size, 32,000 plus square feet, closely matches this operators own stated Data Center A size, this address is applied to this row as the likely Data Center A building with reasonable confidence, corroborated by two independent methods, though the underlying street address itself is not published on this operators own site directly. The aggregators separately listed DC1 address does not match either of this registrys two Liquid Web rows and is not applied to any row.

reading.body:
Liquid Web operates a 32,000 square foot data center in Lansing, Michigan with published capacity for 8,000 servers and a utility power feed of 13,500 kVA across its two-building Lansing campus. The utility figure is stated in alternating current capacity rather than IT load, so a direct conversion to megawatts of usable compute power is not published. Assuming typical power distribution losses and that IT load represents roughly 70 percent of utility capacity, the 13,500 kVA feed suggests roughly 6.4 MW available for compute, which at 40 kW per rack would equip approximately 160 racks.

This facility is the only data center in Michigan with any published power specification in this site's registry. The state has six mapped facilities total and zero megawatts of published IT capacity excluding this campus, which places this campus first by the only metric available. No performance or workload certifications are published for the site.

The campus is expandable and serves web hosting and cloud services tenants through a private operator based in the state. Whether this facility is positioned for AI workloads, specialized cooling, or GPU density is not indicated in published specifications. The actual allocation of power and server capacity between its two buildings is not confirmed in public materials.
